scope: Three user-reviewed technical SEO issues; not a site-wide audit.

findings.title: Missing JobPosting on live jobs
findings.reason: Removed serializer-wide suppression when remote applicant country is unknown. Unavailable jobs still omit JobPosting. No invented geography, salary or deadlines.

findings.title: Eight equivalent unfiltered impact pages
findings.reason: Kept remote-social-impact-jobs; seven aliases permanently redirect directly to it and are removed from shared navigation and keyword sitemap configuration. Query strings preserved.
findings.verification: All seven bare URLs and query-string variants returned 301; keyword sitemap contains retained URL and excludes seven aliases. Old anonymous page-cache entry invalidated.

findings.title: Duplicate job page canonicals
findings.reason: Live reviewed duplicate mappings and matching source-posting identities share one canonical URL. Matching title or numeric suffix alone is not enough. JSON-LD URL and identifier agree with canonical.
findings.verification: Original and copy both return 200; copy canonical and JSON-LD point to original. Tests preserve distinct requisitions and country variants, and avoid closed targets.

reviewed_mapping.storage: Existing JobSlugRedirect model; row created in production after identity checks.

findings.title: Title may truncate on some devices
findings.reason: Unchanged 697.8px heuristic on Managing Director title. Outside these three fixes; not a Google limit or demonstrated defect.

findings.title: Canonical differs from final URL
findings.reason: Expected and explicitly requested for a duplicate job copy. Local fixture host mismatch is also intentional; fixtures retain the production canonical domain.

local_verification.tested_both: Working tree and isolated index checkout excluding unrelated work.
local_verification.audit_page_reports: Repeated for COO, duplicate job and impact alias against controlled local Django fixtures and production. All reports read in full; none truncated.
local_verification.fixture_warnings: Local reports exclude non-HTTP links from link evidence; they do not invalidate JobPosting or redirects.

limitations: Schema presence and JSON serialization were checked; Google Rich Results Test and subsequent indexing are not verified.
1292 remote listings still lack documented country eligibility. They now retain factual JobPosting, but Google Jobs inclusion may still require source-backed eligibility data.
Generic duplicate inference deliberately requires shared source identity; the cross-source GitLab example uses an explicit reviewed mapping.
Source/template changes do not guarantee rankings, traffic, indexing or appearance in Google Jobs.
